richiami.difetto: Certain side shafts and CV joints manufactured in China do not meet GKN Automotive’s heightened original equipment level specifications for ultimate strength.
richiami.rimedio: GKN Automotive will reimburse any customers for the cost of the recalled side shaft or CV joint and for their labour to install a replacement side shaft or CV joint of their choosing. GKN Automotive will also repurchase any remaining inventory from any distributors or retailers.
richiami.titolo: GKN Automotive Aftermarket Sideshafts and CV Joints
